# Google's YARA-L examples

Code blocks copied unchanged from Google Security Operations documentation (`https://cloud.google.com/chronicle/docs/` + the page in the file name, the block at the line it names, fetched 2026-11-12). Google publishes its code samples under the Apache License 2.0 (`../external/LICENSE.Apache-2.0.txt`); the pages' text is CC BY 4.0. `cases.tsv` gives each file the error codes yara-l-1.0 1.1 expects; `crates/opentide-yaral/tests/google_examples.rs` checks them.
